cands.bio: Republican state senator for Alabama's District 9 since January 2024. Served in the Alabama House (District 27) from 2018 to 2024. Former director of basketball operations at the University of Denver, former president of the Arab Chamber of Commerce, and an insurance agent at Holloway and Hunt Insurance in Arab.
cands.gaps: We found no documented statements or actions by Kitchens on data centers, homestead property taxes, land ownership by investors or foreigners, growth and land protection, immigration or H-1B, police and public order, gun laws, abortion, or school choice and teacher pay. The sponsored-legislation list on his Ballotpedia page did not load, so we cannot say which bills he sponsored. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate surveys, and no endorsements were found. We found no documented controversies, no foreign ties, and no public statements on data centers or development. The date he first became an insurance agent, and the dates of his University of Denver job and his Chamber of Commerce presidency, were not found.

qual.background: He served in the Alabama House from 2018 to 2024 and has served in the Alabama Senate since January 2024. He also served as president of the Arab Chamber of Commerce and worked as an insurance agent. He sat on the House Ways and Means General Fund Committee in 2021-2024.
qual.why: He has about eight years of prior and current legislative service in both chambers, plus a business career in insurance. A committee seat adds nothing to the score, and the chamber-leadership criterion is not documented.
